headline: Record profit and cash build as diversified assets deliver
summary_short: Hudbay reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $757.3 million and net income of $190.4 million, up from $594.9 million and $100.4 million a year earlier, driven by higher copper and gold volumes and record EBITDA of $460.9 million.
summary_long: Revenue rose 27% year-over-year to $757.3 million on stronger copper and gold performance across Peru, Manitoba and British Columbia. Net income attributable to owners nearly doubled to $190.4 million (diluted EPS $0.48), and EBITDA reached a record $460.9 million. Cash rose to $1.00 billion from $568.9 million at year-end, boosted by Mitsubishi's $422.7 million cash contribution for its new 30% stake in Copper World, which closed in January 2026 with Hudbay retaining 70% control. On April 1, Hudbay repaid its $472.5 million 2026 notes using cash on hand plus a $272.0 million revolver draw. The filed financial statements include no updated production or cost guidance.
confidence_notes: C1 cash cost and AISC by-product figures are not included: the fetch budget (3/3 used locating and retrieving the EDGAR filing) was exhausted before the MD&A/press-release narrative exhibit could be fetched, so no per-pound cost or production data is available this run — flagged as a gap, not fabricated. Diluted EPS ($0.48) reconciles exactly to the filed interim statements (basic and diluted both $0.48); the resolver's wire-sourced 'eps_usd' figure ($0.40) does not match and is likely a non-GAAP/adjusted EPS measure — noted, not reconciled. Resolver 'operating_income_usd_m' ($302.6M) differs slightly from the filed 'results from operating activities' line ($305.2M); classification difference not investigated. 'ebitda_usd_m' ($460.9M) is a non-GAAP figure not present in the filed statements and could not be verified against SEC data this run. reported_at uses the 6-K filing date (2026-05-01, board-approved 2026-04-30); this differs from the resolver's shard eventDate (2026-04-15), which appears stale — the filing date is used as the more authoritative source per procedure. Revenue includes a small (-$0.1M) prior-period gold/silver stream variable-consideration true-up.
